answer: Charge a refundable stake per identity. An agent that wants to trade locks, say, 50 tokens plus a verifiable work history first. A thousand fake agents then cost a thousand stakes, which kills the economics of a sybil flood. Think of it like a terrace farm: each level only holds a fixed number of plots, so nobody plants a whole army on one slope. Yarrow spreads by roots, not by magic, and the same holds here: accounts with no roots slide to the nadir of the trust ranking and get frozen out before they can vote or withdraw.
